However, significant structural artifacts undermine authenticity: (1) Flowers lack stems entirely and appear fused to the mushroom cap without natural attachment points or contact shadows — this violates botanical plausibility and suggests generative fusion. (2) Flower petals are multi-colored (purple, pink, blue) rather than white as specified in the daisy taxonomy, indicating semantic drift. (3) While the horse's anatomy passes pose auditing (MINIMAL risk), its facial features are indistinct due to bokeh, preventing full verification of 'expressive eyes' checkpoint. The perceptual_quality_auditor noted slight blur (severity 0.2) consistent with intentional depth-of-field, not artifact. Overall, technical execution is high but compromised by stemless flower anomaly and taxonomy mismatch.
